name: lammps-web-gui
description: Run LAMMPS molecular dynamics in your browser: visual input-script builder, MD notebook with an engine checked against native LAMMPS, CMake compiler helper, and a GPU 3D viewer for LAMMPS data/dump, XYZ, PDB and CIF. No install, nothing uploaded.

paragraphs: No install, no account, nothing uploaded · free for education and non-commercial research · attribution required · commercial use needs a licence
LAMMPS Web GUI is a browser-based workbench for LAMMPS, the molecular dynamics code from Sandia National Laboratories. It has four modules:
features: 🧮 MD Notebook — LAMMPS input in the browser, on the GPU or on CPU threads. Type LAMMPS input into notebook cells, press Run, and watch the system move in the 3D view while thermo output fills a table and live…

🌿 Concept branching — divergent ideas in one flowchart. Hover any step and hit the branch icon to fork the pipeline from that point onward. The new concept starts as a copy of the rest of your pipeline, so you edit a…

✅ Script check — validation against the LAMMPS rules, not vibes. A linter reads the final script (generated or hand-edited) and flags what LAMMPS would reject or silently do wrong: header-only commands used after the…

⬇️ Pipeline-order emission. The script comes out in exactly the order the flowchart shows, because LAMMPS executes an input file top to bottom and the docs are explicit that the settings/run phases "can be repeated as…

🧪 Four integrated modules: the MD Notebook above, a visual Script Builder (branching flowchart pipeline over 185 curated commands — the complete general-command surface, locked by a coverage test against…
